layout_and_spacing.global_padding: p-4 or p-6 for mobile screens
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-lg (subtle, medieval aesthetic avoids overly round shapes)
layout_and_spacing.strategy: The background should evoke a dark stone castle or tavern table (dark colors or texture). Floating elements like Quest Cards or Profiles should look like parchment scrolls (cream background, dark text, subtle brown/gold borders).

components.buttons: Solid royal gold (#D4AF37) or deep burgundy (#722F37) with text_on_dark. Use thick bottom borders (e.g. border-b-4) to simulate physical wooden or metal buttons. Press down animation.
components.cards: Parchment colored surface (#F4EBD0). Dark text. Add border-2 border-[#A3862C] or brown to simulate framed paper.
components.avatars: Circular or shield-shaped frames. Use thick gold borders (border-4 border-[#D4AF37]).
components.progress_bars: XP bar should have a dark stone-like track (#1E1E1E) and a glowing green/gold fill. Use rounded-full but with a metallic/gold border wrapper.
components.icons: Use @expo/vector-icons (FontAwesome5, MaterialCommunityIcons) for medieval props: shield, sword, crown, gem, scroll, coins.

image_urls.description: Aged parchment paper texture for quest cards and message boards.
Dark stone wall texture for the main app background or Boss Mode dashboard.
Medieval knight portrait for profile avatar selection (Knight class).
Fantasy shield to represent rank badges (Squire, Knight, Legend).

motion.hover: Not applicable for mobile React Native. Focus on Pressable interactions (scale down to 0.95 opacity 0.8 on press).
motion.transitions: Use standard React Navigation transitions, maybe add a bounce effect to level-up modals.
motion.wheel_of_fate: Implement a spin animation using React Native Animated for the rewards wheel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for Expo React Native. Use pure React Native components (View, Text, Pressable, ScrollView, Animated).
Do NOT use HTML/CSS elements (div, span) or Tailwind web classes, you must use StyleSheet or NativeWind if configured, but prioritize standard React Native styling principles.
Maintain the medieval aesthetic: deep colors, parchment cards, gold accents.
Since custom fonts might require extra setup, if using standard text, use bold, serif styles or styled typography matching the medieval look. If you can load 'Cinzel' via expo-font, do so.
Implement PIN-protected profiles: Zach, Jacob, Boss Mode.
Implement Quest Board: Chores with XP and Gold values.
Ensure the UI feels gamified (XP bars, level badges, gear lockers).
Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, list items) have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., testID='quest-submit-button') for automated testing.
